// ===== File upload preview (single source of truth: _fileStore array) =====
function previewFiles(input, containerId) {
    var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!container) return;
    if (!input._fileStore) input._fileStore = [];
    // Merge genuinely new files from input.files (browser file dialog) into _fileStore
    if (input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        for (var i = 0; i < input.files.length; i++) {
            var f = input.files[i], dup = false;
            for (var j = 0; j < input._fileStore.length; j++) {
                if (input._fileStore[j].name === f.name && input._fileStore[j].size === f.size && input._fileStore[j].lastModified === f.lastModified) { dup = true; break; }
            }
            if (!dup) input._fileStore.push(f);
        }
    }
    // Rebuild input.files from _fileStore for form submission
    var dt = new DataTransfer();
    for (var i = 0; i < input._fileStore.length; i++) dt.items.add(input._fileStore[i]);
    input.files = dt.files;
    // Render previews
    container.innerHTML = '';
    input._fileStore.forEach(function(file, idx) {
        var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.className = 'position-relative';
        wrapper.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;';
        if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
            var div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'border rounded p-1 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center';
            div.style.cssText = 'width:80px;height:80px;';
            div.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-file-pdf text-danger" style="font-size:1.5rem;"></i>';
            wrapper.appendChild(div);
            wrapper.appendChild(createRemoveBtn(idx, input));
            container.appendChild(wrapper);
            return;
        }
        // IIFE to capture idx for async reader.onload
        (function(w, ix, inp) {
            var reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                var div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'border rounded p-1';
                div.style.cssText = 'width:80px;height:80px;';
                div.innerHTML = '<img src="'+e.target.result+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;">';
                w.appendChild(div);
                w.appendChild(createRemoveBtn(ix, inp));
                container.appendChild(w);
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        })(wrapper, idx, input);
    });
}
function createRemoveBtn(idx, input) {
    var btn = document.createElement('span');
    btn.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:-8px;right:-8px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444;color:#fff;border:none;font-size:12px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';

}
// Paste image files into a label's file input — shared by inline handler and document listener
function pasteImageToLabel(label, items) {
    var input = label.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
    if (!input) return;
    if (!input._fileStore) input._fileStore = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (items[i].type.indexOf('image') !== 0) continue;
        var blob = items[i].getAsFile();
        var file = new File([blob], 'paste-' + Date.now() + '.png', { type: blob.type });
        input._fileStore.push(file);
    }
    var dt = new DataTransfer();
    for (var j = 0; j < input._fileStore.length; j++) dt.items.add(input._fileStore[j]);
    input.files = dt.files;
    var container = input.parentElement.nextElementSibling;
    if (container && container.id && container.id.includes('Preview')) {

    }
}

var isEmbedded = window !== window.top;
// 通知轮询：仅非嵌入模式执行

    setInterval(fetchNotifications, 60000);
    fetchNotifications();
}

if (isEmbedded) {
    // 登录过期 → 全页跳转到登录
    if (window.location.pathname.indexOf('/login') === 0) {
        window.top.location.href = '/login';
    }
    // 403 → 通知父页面
    if (document.title === '无权访问') {
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'tabError', error: 'forbidden' }, window.location.origin);
    }

    // 拦截 iframe 内链接点击，通知父页面创建新标签
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var a = e.target.closest('a');
        if (!a) return;
        if (a.getAttribute('data-bs-toggle') || a.getAttribute('data-bs-dismiss') || a.getAttribute('onclick') || a.getAttribute('target') || a.hasAttribute('download')) return;
        var href = a.getAttribute('href');
        if (!href || href === '#' || href.startsWith('javascript:') || href.startsWith('mailto:') || href.startsWith('tel:')) return;
        // 本站绝对 URL 转为相对路径
        if (href.startsWith(window.location.origin)) href = href.substring(window.location.origin.length);
        // 外部链接不拦截，让浏览器正常处理
        if (href.startsWith('http://') || href.startsWith('https://') || href.startsWith('//')) return;

// ===== 标签页导航 =====
var tabMode = localStorage.getItem('tabMode') === '1';
var tabs = [];
var activeTabId = null;
var _rsListeners = [];

function saveTabs() {
    var data = tabs.map(function(t){ return {id:t.id,url:t.url,title:t.title}; });
    sessionStorage.setItem('tabs', JSON.stringify(data));
    sessionStorage.setItem('activeTab', activeTabId);
}

function loadTabs() {
    try {
        var d = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('tabs') || '[]');
        tabs = d.map(function(t){ return {id:t.id,url:t.url,title:t.id==='dashboard'?'仪表盘':t.title,iframe:null}; });
        activeTabId = sessionStorage.getItem('activeTab') || null;
    } catch(e) { tabs = []; activeTabId = null; }
}

function toggleTabMode() {
    tabMode = !tabMode;
    localStorage.setItem('tabMode', tabMode ? '1' : '0');
    applyTabMode();
}

function applyTabMode() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('tabModeToggle');
    var bar = document.getElementById('tabBar');
    var tc = document.getElementById('tabContent');
    var nc = document.getElementById('normalContent');

    document.body.classList.toggle('tab-mode-active', tabMode);
    if (tabMode) {
        btn.classList.add('active');
        bar.classList.remove('hidden');
        tc.classList.remove('hidden');
        // 切到标签模式先回顶部，避免 .main 残留滚动；tabContent 高度由 CSS flex 自动填充，无需 JS 量算
        var mainEl = document.querySelector('.main');
        if (mainEl) mainEl.scrollTop = 0;
        tc.style.height = '';
        nc.style.display = 'none';
        loadTabs();
        if (tabs.length === 0) {
            openTab('/', '仪表盘');
        } else {
            var act = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.id === activeTabId; }) || tabs[0];
            switchTab(act.id, false);
        }
        renderTabs();
    } else {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
        bar.classList.add('hidden');
        tc.classList.add('hidden');
        tc.style.height = '';
        nc.style.display = '';
        tc.innerHTML = '';
        _rsListeners.forEach(function(fn){ window.removeEventListener('resize', fn); });
        _rsListeners = [];
    }
}

function renderTabs() {
    var list = document.getElementById('tabList');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    tabs.forEach(function(t) {
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'tab-item' + (t.id === activeTabId ? ' active' : '') + (t.id === 'dashboard' ? ' pinned' : '');
        el.title = t.title || t.url;
        el.innerHTML = '<span style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">' + (t.title || t.url || '新标签') + '</span>' +
            (t.id !== 'dashboard' ? '<span class="tab-close" onclick="event.stopPropagation();closeTab(\'' + t.id + '\')">×</span>' : '');
        el.onclick = function() { switchTab(t.id); };
        list.appendChild(el);
    });
}

function openTab(url, title) {
    var id = url === '/' ? 'dashboard' : 'tab_' + Date.now();
    var existing = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.url === url; });
    if (existing) { var ef = document.getElementById('tabContent').querySelector('iframe[data-tab-id="' + existing.id + '"]'); if (ef) ef.contentWindow.location.reload(); switchTab(existing.id); return; }
    // 标签上限 8，超限关闭最早的非仪表盘标签
    if (tabs.length >= 8) {
        var oldest = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.id !== 'dashboard'; });
        if (oldest) closeTab(oldest.id);
    }
    tabs.push({ id:id, url:url, title:title || '', iframe:null });
    activeTabId = id;
    switchTab(id);
    renderTabs();
    saveTabs();
}

function switchTab(id, render) {
    if (render === undefined) render = true;
    activeTabId = id;
    var t = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.id === id; });
    if (!t) return;
    if (render) renderTabs();
    saveTabs();

    // 更新侧边栏高亮 — 按路径前缀最长匹配
    var sideLinks = document.querySelectorAll('#sidebar a.nav-link');
    for (var i = 0; i < sideLinks.length; i++) sideLinks[i].classList.remove('active');
    var targetPath = t.url.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
    var best = null, bestLen = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < sideLinks.length; i++) {
        var l = sideLinks[i];
        var h = (l.getAttribute('href') || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
        if (targetPath === '/' && h === '/') { best = l; break; }
        if (h !== '/' && targetPath.startsWith(h) && h.length > bestLen) { best = l; bestLen = h.length; }
    }
    if (best) best.classList.add('active');

    var tc = document.getElementById('tabContent');
    if (!tc.classList.contains('hidden')) { var top = tc.getBoundingClientRect().top; tc.style.height = (window.innerHeight - top) + 'px'; }

    var existing = tc.querySelector('iframe[data-tab-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (existing) {
        tc.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(function(f){ f.style.display = 'none'; });
        existing.style.display = 'block';
        return;
    }

    tc.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(function(f){ f.style.display = 'none'; });
    var frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    frame.setAttribute('data-tab-id', id);
    frame.src = t.url;
    frame.className = 'oms-tab-iframe';
    frame.onload = function() { renderTabs(); saveTabs(); };
    tc.appendChild(frame);
    t.iframe = frame;
}

function closeTab(id) {
    var idx = tabs.findIndex(function(t){ return t.id === id; });
    if (idx < 0 || tabs[idx].id === 'dashboard') return;
    var tc = document.getElementById('tabContent');
    var frame = tc.querySelector('iframe[data-tab-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (frame) frame.remove();
    tabs.splice(idx, 1);
    if (activeTabId === id) {
        activeTabId = tabs[tabs.length - 1] ? tabs[tabs.length - 1].id : null;
        if (activeTabId) switchTab(activeTabId);
    }
    renderTabs();
    saveTabs();
}

// 拦截侧边栏链接
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {

// 监听 iframe 内的导航消息
window.addEventListener('message', function(e) {
    if (!tabMode || e.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
    if (e.data && e.data.type === 'openTab') {
        openTab(e.data.url, e.data.title);
    }
    if (e.data && e.data.type === 'tabError') {
        var tab = tabs.find(function(t){ return t.iframe && t.iframe.contentWindow === e.source; });
        if (tab) {
            alert('当前页面无权访问，标签已关闭');
            closeTab(tab.id);
        }
    }
});

// 页面初始化（iframe 内不启动标签模式，移动端强制关闭）
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && tabMode) {
        tabMode = false;
        localStorage.setItem('tabMode', '0');
    }
    if (tabMode && !isEmbedded) applyTabMode();
});
</script>
